history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration take appropriate action to hold the entities accountable in the exercise of their delegated authority to grant exceptions to human resources administration instructions and to avoid having entities implement exceptions outside their delegated authority in the future.
history.administration_response: The Administration is working on the development of the escalation component of the response mechanism to reinforce the holding of managers accountable for the exercise of delegated authorities. The development work on the vetting automation project is being finalized for user testing and approval, with a roll-out of the automated feature forecasted for second quarter of 2023. It should be noted that the vetting project is limited to positions in the Secretariat only and is not applied system-wide.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration is planning to improve guidance to entities on delegated authority for human resource exceptions and, in 2023, will roll out the escalation component of the response mechanism to reinforce the holding of managers accountable for the exercise of delegated authorities, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration take appropriate action to hold the entities accountable in the exercise of their delegated authority to grant exceptions to human resources administration instructions and to avoid having entities implement exceptions outside their delegated authority in the future.
history.administration_response: The Administration respectfully requests the status of this recommendation to be updated to overtaken by events as this recommendation has been reiterated in chapter II, paragraph 401, of A/78/5 (Vol. I). The Administration will continue to provide entities with guidance on how to exercise the delegated authority to grant human resources exceptions in a compliant manner and will enhance the monitoring tool available to entities to self-monitor in their first line of defence duties. In parallel, the Administration is working to strengthen the escalation component of the response mechanism to reinforce holding managers accountable for the exercise of delegated authorities, and it is conducting a pilot on the issue of human resources exceptions.
history.board_assessment: Given that this recommendation has been reiterated in chapter II, paragraph 401, of A/78/5 (Vol. I), the Board considers this recommendation to be overtaken by events.
